name: A Estrada (Spain)
description: Divided by a white band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green at the hoist and red at the fly.
history: The arms and flag of A Estrada were approved in 2014, published in the Diario Oficial de Galicia on 13 October 2014; the flag is divided by a white bend, green at the hoist and red at the fly.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
